meta.title: Improve join performance with hashed left join
meta.body_summary: Add hash-based optimization for left joins in the Mochi VM, update left join intermediate representation and benchmarks to reflect improved performance.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit hash join optimization merged without review; narrative claims updated benchmarks but no numbers provided, only IR output and minor benchmark file changes.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Hash join optimization in a language VM requires deep knowledge of the runtime, IR representation, and join semantics; Codex delivered a working change that was merged without review, suggesting capability in this stack.
